hebrewText: וּ/מָצָ֤א אֹת/וֹ֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּ֔ם מִ/ח֕וּץ לִ/גְב֖וּל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑/וֹ וְ/רָצַ֞ח גֹּאֵ֤ל הַ/דָּם֙ אֶת הָ֣/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ דָּֽם

tokens.bdb: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
tokens.kjv: [phrase] be able, befall, being, catch, [idiom] certainly, (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver, be enough (cause to) find(-ing, occasion, out), get (hold upon), [idiom] have (here), be here, hit, be left, light (up-) on, meet (with), [idiom] occasion serve, (be) present, ready, speed, suffice, take hold on.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] in any wise, [idiom] at all, avenger, deliver, (do, perform the part of near, next) kinsfolk(-man), purchase, ransom, redeem(-er), revenger.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property
tokens.explanation: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property
tokens.explanationEn: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property

tokens.kjv: abroad, field, forth, highway, more, out(-side, -ward), street, without.

tokens.bdb: properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extension the territory inclosed
